skillTypeInfo.ATK Boost: The Skills with ATK Boost effect can buff the ATK stat of the affected ally(s).
skillTypeInfo.AoE: The AoE (Area of Effect) attack inflicts damages to multiple enemies in the range at once. This skill type usually comes with wider attack range or/and longer attack distance, but also with slower attack speed.
skillTypeInfo.Burn: The Skills with Burn effect inflict Fire type damage over time.
skillTypeInfo.Chain: The Chain attack inflicts damages to multiple enemies as the strike bounces to another nearby enemy across lanes multiple times.
skillTypeInfo.DEF Boost: The Skills with DEF Boost effect can buff the Defense stat of the affected ally(s).
skillTypeInfo.DMG Boost: The Skills with Damage Boost effect can buff the final damage of the affected ally(s).
skillTypeInfo.Damage Boost: The Skills with Damage Boost effect can buff the final damage of the affected ally(s).
skillTypeInfo.Fragile: The Skills with Fragile effect are known to reduce the target's DEF.
skillTypeInfo.Heal: The Skills with Heal effects can recover HP for the user or allies.
skillTypeInfo.Invincible: The Skills with Invincible effect grant the user to take no damages from enemies' attacks.
skillTypeInfo.Knockback: The Skills with Knockback effect can push out the target(s).
skillTypeInfo.Paralyze: The Skills with Paralyze effect inflict Lightning type damage over time and delay the target's movement.
skillTypeInfo.Pierce: The Pierce attack fires a projectile that can go through the target multiple times on hit, dealing damages to multiple targets similar to AoE.
skillTypeInfo.Planting: The Skills with Planting type summon object(s) with special effect(s) on the board.
skillTypeInfo.Pull: The Pull tag denotes skills that displace targets toward the user. Generally does not affect other Tataris.
skillTypeInfo.Self Heal: The Skills with Self Heal effects recover the user itself.
skillTypeInfo.Slow: The Skills with Slow effects can lower the movement speed of affected targets.
skillTypeInfo.Split: The Split attack fires a projectile that splits into multiple projectiles on hit.
skillTypeInfo.Summon: Skills with Summon effects summon another targetable unit under certain conditions.
skillTypeInfo.Weaken: The Skills with Weaken effect reduces the target's damage.
